title: Secret space program friend's father's 'simulacrum' joke

tellings.quote: in encounters Diana also interviews a friend who's was allegedly part of one of the secret American space programs something like the one Tyler from American Cosmic was in

plain: In Encounters, a book by the religion scholar Diana Pasulka, she interviews a friend who was allegedly part of one of America's secret space programs, meaning hidden space efforts said to run outside the public one. Michels brings this up himself while summarising her book. He compares the friend to Tyler, a figure in Pasulka's earlier book American Cosmic who is described as having been in a similar program. Michels gives nothing more about the friend's father or the joke about a 'simulacrum', a copy or imitation, that the story's title mentions.
